product_metadata.title: Shoe Rack with 8 Shelves-Eight Tiers for 48 Pairs-For Bedroom, Entryway, Hallway, and Closet- Space Saving Storage and Organization by Home-Complete
features: 8-TIER SHOE STORAGE – Featuring eight tiers of shoe racks, you will be able to conveniently fit up to 48 pairs of shoes. Made from a high-quality plastic, this closet shoe organizer is a sturdy and durable option for your home.

SPACE SAVING – The shoe rack organizer is both multi-functional and practical, as it provides a compact, space-saving solution for storing your footwear, and can be used to hold other items as well. It’s ideal for any home, apartment, or dorm.

USE IN ANY ROOM – This shoe rack is an excellent option to keep any room of the home neat and clutter free. Use it in your entryway, garage, bedroom, or bathroom. The slatted design of the shoes rack offers ventilation and drainage for your footwear.

EASY ASSEMBLY – With no tools required, the shoe rack for closet floor is quick and easy to put together, no fuss. Simply fasten the rails to the side rails of the shoe organizer cubby and you are done.

PRODUCT DETAILS – Material: High-Quality Polymer Plastic. Dimensions: (L) 40.9” x (W) 11.8” x (H) 60.6”. Dust the closet shoe rack with a soft cloth, duster, or wipe clean with a damp cloth. Color: Gray and White.
description: The Shoe Organizer for Closet Floor by Home-Complete is the perfect storage solution for any home. With eight tiers of shelving, you can conveniently store up to 48 pairs of shoes on this shoe shelf closet organizer. Constructed from sturdy high-quality plastic, this shoe stand is a durable and long-lasting organizational solution. The tall shoe rack is a great space saving item for any house, dorm, or apartment and is an excellent option to keep your entryway, hallway, bedroom, or bathroom neat and clutter free.
